packageDiffs.description: Map of package name and the {@link SourceControlFileDiff} that changed within that package

unassignedFileDiffs.description: Array of {@link SourceControlFileDiff} that do not belong to a particular package

title:
Groups {@link SourceControlFileDiff}s into their parent packages.
If a {@link SourceControlFileDiff} does not have a parent package, it will be found in `unassignedFileDiffs`.
